transcript.text: Every time I put the oven on it runs for a few minutes and then the trip switch goes and half the house loses power. Reset it 3 times tonight. Hotpoint built-in, about 9 years old. What could cause this?

⚠ Stop using this appliance
Please don't keep resetting the trip. Leave the appliance unplugged and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer before using it again. Stop using the oven immediately. Repeatedly resetting the trip switch is unsafe because it suggests an electrical fault (likely a heating element leaking electricity to earth) that could cause fire or shock. The fact that it runs for a few minutes before tripping often means the insulation breaks down as the component heats up. This cannot be fixed by the homeowner and requires a qualified engineer to isolate the appliance and test the elements safely. Please have an engineer inspect it before using it again.

candidates.cause: Internal wiring or terminal block insulation failure
